body: The implementation is functionally correct, but it introduces a classic N+1 query problem. This will lead to severe performance degradation as the number of users grows. Please refactor to use a more efficient data retrieval strategy.

comments.body: 🚨 N+1 Query Problem: You are performing a database query for every single user in the loop. If you have 1,000 users, you'll execute 1,001 queries. Consider using a JOIN or fetching all posts for these users in a single query using an IN clause.

🚨 N+1 Query Problem: This is a textbook example of the N+1 problem. The database will be hammered with repeated requests for posts. Refactor the PostRepository to support bulk fetching or use a JOIN in a custom query to retrieve users and their posts in one go.
